paite: TOUPA aw, nang phulakna thunei Pathian, nang phulakna thunei, Pathian, vakkhia in.
heading: Pathian, Mi Teng Vaihawmpa

paite: Nang lei a vaihawmpa, kisa inla; kisatheite agitlouh man uh thuk in.
TOUPA, migilou-saloute bang tan ahia, bang tan ahia avualzoh ding uh?
Amaute amawk pau ua, kisatheitak in thu agen ua; thil hihkhialte tengteng akiphat tawm uhi.
TOUPA aw, na mite akeknensak ua, na gouluah ahihgim uhi.
Meithai leh mikhual athat ua, pa nei lou athat uhi.
TOUPA'N amu kei ding, Jakob' Pathian in angaihtuah sam kei ding, achi uhi.
Mi lak a mimawlte aw, ngaihtuah un; mihaite aw, chikchiang in na pil ding ua?
Bil phutpa'n aza kei dia hia? Mitsiampa'n amu kei dia hia?
Namte thuzohpa'n na taihilh kei dia hia, mihing pilna hilhpa'n?
TOUPA'N mihing ngaihtuahnate bangmah lou phet ahi chih athei hi.
TOUPA aw, mi na thuzoh a, na dan thu a pan sin mite ahampha uhi.
Migilou a dia kokhuk toh a a-om masiah, mangbat nite a pan khawlna na piakna ding in.
TOUPA'N amite apaikhe dek kei a, agoutan apaisan sam kei ding hi.
Vaihawmna diktatna ah akik nawn dia, lungtang diktak pu tengteng in huai azui ding uhi.
Kua ahia thil hoih lou hihte hon dousak ding a kisa ding? Thil hihkhialte hon dousak ding in kua adingh dia?
TOUPA hon panpihpa hi keileh, ka hinna mundai ah a-om pah ding hi.
Ka khe ateu a, ka chih in, aw TOUPA, na zahngaihna in ahon kai hi.
Ka lungsim angaihtuah tampi ka neih lai in, na khamuannate'n ka hinna аhihnuam zel hi.
Gitlouh satlouhna laltutphah, dan a thilhihkhelhna omsak in, nang hon kithuahpih dia hia?
Midiktat hinna sual tum in apungkhawm ua, sisan gensiatbei siam louh atangsak nak uhi.
Himahleh TOUPA ka insang ahi a; ka Pathian ka kihumbitna suangpi ahi.
Akhelhna uh atung uah akesak a, ahoihlouhna ah ahihmangthang ding a; TOUPA i Pathian in ahihmang ding hi.
